props.heading: Aapke naap ka steel furniture, hamare apne workshop se
props.sub: Medicine rack, pharmacy counter, almirah, shop display, school furniture aur custom fabrication — naap se lekar installation tak, pura kaam Nagpur mein hamari apni team karti hai.

props.label: Kyun Sonu Steel Furniture
props.heading: Yahin banta hai, bahar se mangwaya nahi jata

props.label: Hamare Baare Mein
props.heading: Jo aapko quote deta hai, wahi workshop chalata hai
props.body:
Sonu Steel Furniture Nagpur mein steel furniture banane aur fabrication ka workshop hai, jise Mohammad Arif chalate hain. Hum showroom nahi hain jo factory ka bheja hua maal aage bech de — naapna, cutting, welding, powder coating aur fitting sab hamare apne haath aur apni team se hota hai.

Isi wajah se yahan 'aapke naap ka' normal baat hai, koi mehnga exception nahi. Pharmacy jiska corner tedha hai, garage jise khaas height ka bench chahiye, school jo ek hi age group ke liye bench le raha hai — sab kuch usi jagah ke naap par draw hota hai, banta hai aur install hota hai.

props.label: Hum Kya Karte Hain
props.heading: Furniture aur fabrication
props.sub: Aath tarah ke kaam, sab ek hi workshop mein.

items.title: Shop & Pharmacy Furniture
items.desc: Counter, wall unit, display cabinet aur drawer bank — aapki dukaan ke hisaab se plan karke ek saath install.
items.body: Zyadatar shop furniture ek-ek karke kharida jata hai aur kabhi theek se line mein nahi aata. Hum dukaan naapte hain, customer ke chalne ke hisaab se layout banate hain, aur har unit usi plan par banate hain.

items.title: Steel Almirah & Wardrobe
items.desc: Do-darwaza, char-darwaza aur wardrobe almirah — locking rod, adjustable shelf, mirror aur locker ke saath.
items.body: Standard size nahi, aapke kamre ki height ke hisaab se; colour aapki pasand ka; aur andar ka layout us cheez ke hisaab se jo aap rakhte hain — hanging, folded, file ya teeno.

items.title: Storage & Display Rack
items.desc: Drawer rack, crate rack, parts rack aur khule display rack — aapke stock aur deewar ke naap ke.
items.body: Rack tabhi kaam ka hai jab usme rakhne wali cheez fit baithe. Crate, box ya part bata dijiye — grid usi ke hisaab se banate hain, aapko standard unit mein adjust nahi karwate.

items.title: School & Institutional Furniture
items.desc: Desk-bench, staff table, storage cupboard aur locker — school aur coaching class ke liye.
items.body: Institution ka furniture ek baar kharida jata hai aur saalon tak sakht istemaal hota hai, isliye joint welded hote hain aur finish aisa jise sambhalna nahi, bas saaf karna pade.

items.title: Workshop & Garage Furniture
items.desc: Workbench, service counter, tool board aur heavy drawer unit — khade hokar kaam karne walon ke liye.
items.body: Working height par banate hain, drawer tools ka weight lene wale, aur board jo spanner bench se hata de.

items.title: Custom Steel Fabrication
items.desc: Drawing par ya site par fabrication — structure, enclosure, gate, frame aur goods lift.
items.body: Jahan furniture khatam hota hai aur fabrication shuru. Drawing le aaiye ya humein site par bula lijiye; naap, banana aur install — teeno hum karte hain.

items.title: Steel Sofa & Seating
items.desc: Sofa frame, bench aur waiting-area seating — powder-coated steel mein, loose cushion ke saath.
items.body: Aisi seating jo public waiting room jhel le, aur cushion aise ki phenkne ke bajaye cover badal jaye.

items.title: Repair, Re-coating & Modification
items.desc: Nayi shelf, naye drawer, dobara welding aur fresh powder coating — aapke purane furniture par.
items.meta: Jinke paas pehle se steel furniture hai
items.body: Steel furniture badalne ki zaroorat kam hi padti hai — hinge, shelf ya re-coat se kaam chal jata hai. WhatsApp par photo bhejiye, hum saaf-saaf bata denge ki banwana faydemand hai ya nahi.

props.label: Hamare Products
props.heading: Kuch cheezein jo hum banate hain
props.sub: Har piece order par banta hai. Kisi bhi product par tap kijiye — uski detail seedhe hamare WhatsApp par chali jayegi.

items.title: Medicine Rack
items.desc: Powder-coated steel ka multi-drawer medicine rack — drawer ki depth aapke stock ke hisaab se.
items.body: Medicine rack ka pura khel drawer ki depth par hai. Kam rakhi to strip bahar nikli rehti hai, zyada rakhi to peeche ka maal expire hone tak nazar hi nahi aata. Hum drawer bank aapke asli stock ke naap par banate hain, aur body powder-coated steel ki hoti hai — din mein sau baar khinchne par bhi saalon chalti hai.

items.title: School Desk & Bench
items.desc: Steel frame aur hardwood top wala do-seater ya teen-seater desk-bench.
items.meta: School aur coaching class ke liye
items.body: Class ka furniture top se nahi, joint se kharab hota hai. Isliye har frame joint welded hota hai, bolt wala nahi, aur likhne wala top fix rehta hai taaki ek hi session mein dheela na pade. Naap us age group ka lete hain jo baithne wala hai — primary aur junior college ki bench ek nahi hoti.

items.title: Pharmacy Counter with Wall Unit
items.desc: Billing counter aur peeche ka wall unit ek set mein — neeche drawer, upar glass display.
items.body: Dono saath isliye banate hain kyunki dono ka line-up milna zaroori hai. Counter par billing, cash drawer aur fast-moving stock ka closed storage; peeche wall unit mein baaki sab ek kadam ki doori par, glass mein — taaki darwaza khole bina dikh jaye kya khatam ho raha hai.

items.title: Glass Display Counter
items.desc: Lamba glass-top display counter, steel frame par — jo maal customer ko dikhna chahiye uske liye.
items.body: Display counter ko upar se weight uthana padta hai aur lambai mein seedha rehna padta hai. Hamara frame welded steel ka hota hai aur glass seat kiya jata hai, dhila rakha nahi. Lambai jitni aapke shop front mein aa jaye — corner ke liye L-shape bhi bana dete hain.

items.title: Two-Door Steel Almirah
items.desc: Locking handle, adjustable shelf aur optional mirror ke saath do-darwaze wali almirah.
items.meta: Ghar, hostel aur office ke liye
items.body: Roz kaam aane wali almirah, sahi tareeke se banayi hui: poori lambai ka locking rod (sirf ek catch nahi), shelf jo zaroorat ke hisaab se upar-neeche ho jayein, aur powder-coated finish jo poochha lagane par kharab nahi hoti. Colour aapki pasand ka.

items.title: Workshop Workbench
items.desc: Neeche drawer bank aur peeche perforated tool board wala heavy workbench.
items.meta: Garage aur service centre ke liye
items.body: Aisa bench jis par khade ho jao to bhi kuch na ho. Mota top, drawer aise runner par jo tools ka weight lein (kagaz ka nahi), aur peeche pegboard taaki spanner deewar par rahein, dher mein nahi. Height un logon ke hisaab se set karte hain jo ispar kaam karenge.

items.title: Service Counter with Tool Board
items.desc: Machine mount, drawer aur khada tool panel — service bay ke liye counter.
items.meta: Workshop aur service bay ke liye
items.body: Jahan job card banta hai aur tools rehte hain. Khada panel bench khali rakhta hai, drawer bank mein consumables, aur mount us machine ka banate hain jo aap chalate hain — bas bata dijiye kaunsi hai.

items.title: Glass Display Cabinet
items.desc: Sliding door aur adjustable glass shelf wala khada glass cabinet.
items.body: Sliding rakhte hain, hinge wala nahi — dukaan ke aisle mein darwaza kholne ki jagah aksar hoti hi nahi. Glass shelf poori height mein adjust hote hain aur frame powder-coated hota hai, isliye shop light mein bhi colour waisa hi rehta hai.

props.heading: Banaya aur install kiya hua

props.label: Timing
props.heading: Workshop kab khula rehta hai
props.note: Ravivaar band. Public holiday par aane se pehle call kar lijiye.

props.heading: Naap bata dijiye, quote hum de denge
props.sub: Jagah ki photo ya measurement WhatsApp par bhejiye — Mohammad Arif khud jawab denge.

items.desc: Powder-coated steel sofa frame, loose cushion ke saath — three-seater ya aapki lambai ka.
items.meta: Ghar, office aur waiting area ke liye
items.body: Waiting room mein steel frame lakdi se zyada chalta hai, aur cushion purane ho jayein to sirf cover badal jata hai, pura sofa nahi. Frame ka colour aur cushion ka kapda dono aapki pasand ka.

items.title: Shop Cash Counter
items.desc: Lockable drawer, khuli shelf aur customer-side panel wala compact cash counter.
items.body: Wahi cheez jiske aas-paas puri dukaan chalti hai. Lockable cash drawer, ek shelf jahan bill book aur card machine dono sach mein aa jayein, aur aage se band panel taaki customer ko aapka storage nahi, saaf front dikhe.

items.title: Vegetable & Crate Rack
items.desc: Standard crate ke naap ka angled multi-tier rack — fruit, sabzi aur loose stock ke liye.
items.meta: Kirana aur sabzi ki dukaan ke liye
items.body: Angle isliye taaki crate customer ki taraf jhuke aur peeche ka maal gayab na ho. Naap standard crate ka hai, isliye naye crate kharidne ki zaroorat nahi, aur itna halka ki dhulai ke waqt ek aadmi hata le.

items.title: Medicine Storage Rack (Long Run)
items.desc: Deewar ki poori lambai ka drawer rack — alag-alag unit jodkar nahi, ek hi run mein banaya hua.
items.meta: Badi pharmacy aur distributor ke liye
items.body: Jab drawer ki deewar alag-alag almari jodkar banti hai, to sabse pehle beech ka gap hi kharab dikhta hai aur wahin dhool jamti hai. Isliye hum poori deewar ka ek hi run banate hain, aur drawer ka grid aapke fast-moving stock ke hisaab se set karte hain.

items.title: Chemist Counter with Drawer Bank
items.desc: Gehre multi-drawer bank aur customer-side raised top ke saath billing counter.
items.body: Counter aur medicine drawer ek hi piece mein, taaki billing karne wala stock se ek ghumav se zyada door na ho. Raised top aapki working surface customer ki nazar se bahar rakhta hai jab woh wait kar raha ho.

items.title: Pharmacy Interior Fit-out
items.desc: Poori dukaan ka interior — counter, wall unit, display cabinet aur storage, saath banaye aur install kiye.
items.body: Khali shop ko poora set karne ke liye. Hum jagah naapte hain, counter ki position customer ki line ke hisaab se plan karte hain, aur har unit usi plan par banate hain — taaki poori dukaan ek kaam lage, alag-alag kharida hua saamaan nahi.

items.title: Steel Bookshelf Rack
items.desc: Steel frame aur wooden shelf wala khula paanch-tier rack.
items.meta: Ghar, office aur library ke liye
items.body: Chaaron taraf se khula, isliye chhota kamra band nahi lagta. Weight steel frame uthata hai, isliye shelf patle rakh sakte hain. Height aur tier ki ginti aapki deewar ke hisaab se.

items.title: Medicine Cabinet with Glass Top
items.desc: Upar glass-front aur neeche drawer bank — dono ek compact cabinet mein.
items.meta: Clinic aur chhoti pharmacy ke liye
items.body: Ek hi jagah mein do tarah ka storage: upar glass ke peeche dikhne wala stock, neeche drawer mein baaki sab. Naap clinic room ya chhoti dukaan ka, jahan pura wall unit nahi aa sakta.

items.title: Wardrobe Almirah with Mirror
items.desc: Poori lambai ke mirror, andar shelf aur locker ke saath do-darwaze wali almirah.
items.body: Bedroom wali standard almirah, un detail ke saath jo roz kaam aate hain: darwaze par mirror, andar chhota locker keemti saaman ke liye, aur shelf ki doori kapdon ke hisaab se — file ke hisaab se nahi.

items.title: Auto Parts Drawer Rack
items.desc: Chhote parts ke liye chaudi multi-drawer rack, ek kinare par boxed stock ki khuli shelf.
items.meta: Auto parts aur hardware shop ke liye
items.body: Chhote parts ke liye chhote drawer chahiye, aur bahut saare. Isliye ise shallow drawer ke grid ki tarah banate hain, har front par label ki jagah, aur ek kinare par khuli shelf un boxes ke liye jo kabhi drawer mein nahi aayenge.

items.title: Goods Lift Fabrication
items.desc: Goods lift ka structure aur enclosure — site par banaya aur install kiya.
items.meta: Dukaan, godown aur workshop ke liye
items.body: Furniture se aage ka fabrication: goods lift ka structure, cage aur enclosure, site par naap kar welding. Ismein zyadatar cheezein site hi tay karti hai, isliye shuruaat catalogue se nahi, ek visit se hoti hai.

props.label: Order Se Pehle
props.heading: Jo sawaal sabse zyada poochhe jate hain

items.q: Kya aap mere naap ka furniture banate hain?
items.a: Haan — hamara zyadatar kaam wahi hai. Naap bhej dijiye, ya jagah ki photo ke saath approximate measurement; hum bata denge kya ban sakta hai aur uska quote de denge.

Size, material aur ek photo ya drawing WhatsApp par bhej dijiye — hum quote kar denge. Rate size, steel ke gauge aur finish par nirbhar karta hai, isliye order-par-banne wale kaam ka fixed rate hum publish nahi karte.
Bata dijiye piece kahan jayega — delivery aur installation quote ke saath confirm kar denge. Bade fit-out aur site ka fabrication hamari apni team install karti hai.

Powder coating mein rang ki acchi range hoti hai — hamari photos mein jo teal, green, blue aur maroon dikhte hain, woh sab customer ki pasand the. Aap shade bata dijiye, coating jitna paas match kar sakti hai karenge.

items.q: Purana furniture repair ya re-coat hota hai?
items.a: Aksar haan, aur naya banwane se sasta padta hai. WhatsApp par photo bhejiye — hum saaf-saaf bata denge ki karwana faydemand hai ya nahi.

items.q: Order mein kitna time lagta hai?
items.a: Piece par, aur workshop mein pehle se kitna kaam hai uspar. Enquiry ke waqt poochh lijiye — hum sach mein milne wali date batayenge, khush karne wali nahi.

props.heading: List mein nahi hai? Phir bhi shayad hum bana denge
props.sub: Hamara zyadatar kaam ek-ek piece ka hota hai. Cheez batayiye, hum bata denge ban sakti hai ya nahi.

Sonu Steel Furniture ka apna unit Satpuda Bar ke peeche, Dighori Road, Aradhana Nagar, Nagpur mein hai. Mohammad Arif ise chalate hain, khud quote karte hain aur banne ke waqt floor par hote hain — yahi wajah hai ki customer do inch gehra drawer maang le to use 'nahi ho sakta' ke bajaye woh drawer milta hai.

Kaam mote taur par do hisson mein hai. Ek hissa steel furniture: medicine rack aur pharmacy counter, almirah aur wardrobe, display cabinet, storage aur parts rack, school bench, workshop furniture aur steel seating. Doosra hissa fabrication — structure, enclosure, frame aur goods lift, site par naap kar welding.

Dono ko jodne wali baat ek hi hai: kuch bhi standard nahi hota, jab tak standard hi sahi na ho. Har piece us jagah ke naap par banta hai jahan woh jayega, customer ke chune hue colour mein finish hota hai, aur wahi log install karte hain jinhone banaya hai.

posts.title: Pharmacy ke liye medicine rack kaise choose karein
posts.excerpt: Drawer ki ginti nahi, drawer ki depth tay karti hai ki rack chalega ya nahi. Order se pehle kya naapna hai.
posts.body:
Shuruaat deewar se nahi, stock se kijiye. Jo strip, box aur bottle sabse zyada chalte hain unhein saamne rakhiye aur sabse gehri cheez naapiye — wahi aapki drawer depth hai. Usse kam rakhi to bhara hua box drawer band nahi hone dega; bahut zyada rakhi to peeche ka maal expiry tak nazar nahi aayega.

Phir yeh giniye ki din bhar mein aap kitni alag categories tak sach mein haath badhate hain. Drawer ki ginti wahi tay karti hai, deewar ki chaudai nahi. Chalis ek jaise drawer dekhne mein achhe lagte hain aur kaam dheema kar dete hain; aapke apne fast movers ke hisaab se bana grid pehle mahine mein hi paisa vasool kar deta hai.

Aakhri baat — aur kaun istemaal karega. Agar do log ek saath billing karte hain to rack counter ke dono taraf se pahunch mein hona chahiye, aur isse uski jagah badal jati hai.

posts.title: MS ya stainless: Nagpur ki dukaan ke liye kaunsa steel
posts.excerpt: Stainless hamesha behtar sauda nahi hai. Kaunsa kis kaam ka hai, aur paisa kahan lagana samajhdari hai.
posts.body:
Mild steel, powder coated — zyadatar shop aur ghar ka furniture isi ka hota hai, aur aksar yahi sahi choice hai. Mazboot hai, colour acha chadhta hai, welding saaf hoti hai, aur stainless ke muqable bahut sasta padta hai. Kamzori sirf ek hai: khada paani. Jahan coating chhil jaye aur geeli rahe, wahin se zang shuru hoti hai.

Stainless apni keemat wahan vasool karta hai jahan paani lagatar rehta hai ya hygiene check hoti hai — wash area, kitchen, hospital aur laboratory furniture. Bedroom ki almirah par stainless ka paisa lagakar aapko aisa kuch nahi milta jo kabhi mehsoos ho.

Nagpur ki humidity mein practical jawab yeh hai: zyadatar dukaanon ke liye acha powder coat wala mild steel, aur stainless sirf un hisson mein jahan paani lagta hai. Confusion ho to bata dijiye piece kahan rakha jayega — hum bata denge kya sahi hai, chahe sasta wala hi sahi ho.

posts.title: Powder coating aur paint: dukaan mein kya zyada chalta hai
posts.excerpt: Workshop finish paint se alag kaise behave karta hai, aur dono ko naya kaise rakhein.
posts.body:
Paint sirf upar baithta hai. Powder coating bake hoti hai, isliye chipak kar mota aur sakht finish banti hai — yahi wajah hai ki chaabi, crate aur trolley se woh bach jati hai jahan paint chhil kar nange metal tak pahunch jata hai.

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki woh tootegi nahi. Gehri chip ab bhi nami ka raasta hai, isliye zang ka dhabba aane se pehle touch-up karwa lena behtar hai. Saaf karne ke liye geela kapda aur halka detergent kaafi hai; tez solvent aur scouring powder chamak utar dete hain aur aisa dull patch chhod jate hain jo phir kabhi match nahi hota.

Purana piece jo chalky ho gaya hai, use strip karke dobara coat karwana naya kharidne se bahut sasta padta hai.

posts.title: Pharmacy counter ka layout: billing, storage aur line
posts.excerpt: Woh faisle jo medical store ko tez banate hain — fabrication shuru hone se pehle.
posts.body:
Pehle yeh tay kijiye ki customer kahan khada hoga. Baaki sab wahin se nikalta hai — billing kahan baithegi, card machine kis taraf hoga, sabse zyada chalne wala stock serve karne wale se kitni door hai.

Billing ki jagah khali rakhiye. Jis counter par computer, printer, bill book aur card machine — chaaron ko jagah chahiye, wahan har ek ki apni shelf honi chahiye, warna chaaron wahin aa jayenge jahan customer ka saaman rakhna tha.

Do logon ke hisaab se plan kijiye, chahe aaj aap akele hain. Ek aadmi ki aisle mein ek doosre ko cross karna hi shaam ki bheed ko dheema karta hai, aur baad mein chaudai badhane ka matlab hai pura counter dobara banwana.

posts.title: Steel furniture ki dekhbhaal — mahine ke paanch minute
posts.excerpt: Mahine mein paanch minute ka kaam, aur woh galtiyan jo furniture ki umar kam kar deti hain.
posts.body:
Geele kapde se poochhiye aur sukha kar dijiye. Bas yahi zyadatar kaam hai. Nuksaan woh paani karta hai jo raat bhar horizontal surface par khada reh jata hai — aksar farsh dhone ke baad.

Saal mein do baar hinge aur locking rod par tel dijiye. Almirah ke darwaze atakne lagein to woh tede nahi hue hote, sirf sookhe hote hain. Ek boond tel unhein theek kar deti hai, jabki zor lagane se frame ka square bigadta hai.

Bhara hua furniture farsh par ghaseetiye mat. Jo frame install hote waqt bilkul square tha, use bigadne ka sabse tez tareeka yahi hai. Khali kijiye, uthaiye — ya humein bata dijiye, hum shift kar denge.

posts.title: Ready-made ya aapke naap ka: custom kab sahi hai
posts.excerpt: Ready-made sasta aur turant milta hai. Kahan woh aakhir mein zyada mehnga padta hai.
posts.body:
Normal kamre mein ek almirah ke liye ready-made hi sahi choice hai. Jo standard size fit ho raha hai, uske liye fabrication ka extra paisa kisi ko nahi dena chahiye.

Custom wahan paisa vasool karta hai jahan jagah tedhi hai ya kaam khaas hai: corner, neechi chhat, do pillar ke beech ki deewar, ya drawer jo aapke stock ke naap ka ho — kisi ke andaaze ka nahi. Dukaan mein to yeh lagbhag hamesha faydemand hai, kyunki counter par bekaar gayi do inch chaudai roz nuksaan karti hai.

Seedha test yeh hai: agar standard piece fit ho raha hai aur kaam kar raha hai, to wahi lijiye. Lekin agar aap pehle se soch rahe hain ki use adjust karenge, kaatenge ya neeche kuch lagayenge — to paisa aap custom ka hi de rahe hain, bas kharab wale custom ka.

items.q: Kya aap mere naap ka furniture banate hain?
items.a: Haan — hamara zyadatar kaam wahi hai. Naap bhej dijiye, ya jagah ki photo ke saath approximate measurement; hum bata denge kya ban sakta hai aur uska quote de denge.

Size, material aur ek photo ya drawing WhatsApp par bhej dijiye — hum quote kar denge. Rate size, steel ke gauge aur finish par nirbhar karta hai, isliye order-par-banne wale kaam ka fixed rate hum publish nahi karte.
Bata dijiye piece kahan jayega — delivery aur installation quote ke saath confirm kar denge. Bade fit-out aur site ka fabrication hamari apni team install karti hai.

Powder coating mein rang ki acchi range hoti hai — hamari photos mein jo teal, green, blue aur maroon dikhte hain, woh sab customer ki pasand the. Aap shade bata dijiye, coating jitna paas match kar sakti hai karenge.

items.q: Purana furniture repair ya re-coat hota hai?
items.a: Aksar haan, aur naya banwane se sasta padta hai. WhatsApp par photo bhejiye — hum saaf-saaf bata denge ki karwana faydemand hai ya nahi.

items.q: Order mein kitna time lagta hai?
items.a: Piece par, aur workshop mein pehle se kitna kaam hai uspar. Enquiry ke waqt poochh lijiye — hum sach mein milne wali date batayenge, khush karne wali nahi.
